name: Citi Strata Elite℠ Card

otherLounges: American Airlines Admirals Club (4 passes per year)
loungeAccess.notes: Complimentary Priority Pass Select membership. Four American Airlines Admirals Club passes per year (not full membership). Enrollment required for Priority Pass.

tripDelay.notes: Trip delay coverage when common carrier is delayed 6+ hours or overnight. Cardholder and immediate family members covered.

tripCancellation.notes: Trip cancellation and interruption coverage when travel is purchased with the card.

lostBaggage.notes: Coverage for lost, stolen, or damaged baggage.

emergencyMedical.notes: No dedicated emergency medical evacuation benefit.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary coverage. Decline the CDW at the rental counter.

hotelCredit.notes: Up to $300 annual hotel benefit: each calendar year, enjoy up to $300 off a hotel stay of two nights or more when booked through cititravel.com.

otherCredits.name: Citi Splurge Credit
otherCredits.notes: $200 annual Splurge Credit for eligible dining, entertainment, and lifestyle purchases. Terms apply — see Citi for current eligible categories.

otherCredits.name: Blacklane Chauffeur Credit
otherCredits.notes: Two $100 credits per year for Blacklane chauffeur service bookings made through Citi.

rewards.baseRate: 1.5x ThankYou® Points per $1 on all other purchases
rewards.travelRate: 12x on Hotels, Car Rentals, and Attractions booked on cititravel.com; 6x on air travel booked on cititravel.com
rewards.diningRate: 6x at restaurants (including delivery) on Citi Nights (Fri–Sat 6PM–6AM ET); 3x all other times

pointValue.transferPartners: Varies — often 0.015-0.02+ with airline partners like American Airlines, JetBlue, Singapore Airlines, Turkish Airlines, Virgin Atlantic

emergencyContacts.benefitsCenter: Refer to card benefit guide for claims
emergencyContacts.claimsCenter: Citi Benefits Center — see card documentation

travelPerks: Priority Pass Select membership (1,300+ global lounges)
4 American Airlines Admirals Club passes per year
$300 annual hotel credit (2-night+ stay via cititravel.com)
$120 Global Entry/TSA PreCheck credit every 4 years
12x points on hotels/car rentals/attractions via cititravel.com
6x points at restaurants on Citi Nights (Fri–Sat 6PM–6AM)
Trip cancellation/interruption up to $5,000 per person
Transfer to 15+ airline partners at 1:1 ratio
bestFor: Premium travelers who can leverage multiple annual credits to offset the $595 fee, especially those who frequent Admirals Clubs and book through the Citi travel portal
